title: First-touch UI tour asset pack for Hosted API
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Produce a compact, export-ready pack of annotated screenshots for the Hosted API first-run interactive tour: model selection grid, inline model details, request-builder walkthrough, and three code snippet examples (Python sync, Python async, JS fetch). Assets must be production quality and accessible.
acceptance_criteria: Three primary artboards exported: Model selection, Request Builder stepper, Code snippets pane
Annotations on each artboard with short UX rationale (1 sentence) for use in docs and console tooltips
PNG exports at 1x and 2x plus SVG for vector elements and model icons
Copy signed off by PM and Content and accessibility contrast verified
Related docs PR and console PR created linking these assets
No customer data or internal-only URLs in published images
decisions: Display three simple badges on model tiles: latency, relative cost, compatibility
Prefer a single example prompt in screenshots to show token estimation rather than a blank request
Create light and dark theme variants for each exported image
Keep microcopy concise; link to full docs for advanced details
Do not surface percentile latency metrics in onboarding images to avoid confusion
feedback: Maya Chen (PM): Reduce numeric clutter on badges; use 'lower/higher cost' labels instead of dollar ranges
Leo Grant (Eng): Add model version pin indicator and a small lock icon to show pinned deployments
June Park (Content): Tone edits applied; 'cheap' replaced with 'lower cost' and CTAs standardized
Samir Rao (Accessibility): Confirmed color contrast adjustments for code block backgrounds and badge text
next_steps: Incorporate PM copy edits and finalize Figma frames by 2026-03-14
Export 1x/2x PNGs and SVGs and upload to Drive under public-assets/onboarding/2026-03
Open docs PR to add images to the Getting Started page and console PR to reference assets
